name: Kuo-Toa Cutter
tactics: A kuo-toa cutter stays in constant motion on the battlefield, using swift strike to dart from target to target.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Aquatic
traits.details: The cutter can breathe underwater. In aquatic combat, it gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against nonaquatic creatures.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature granting combat advantage to the cutter

hit.description: damage, and the target is slowed and takes ongoing 10 damage (save ends both).

powers.name: Slick Maneuver
powers.requirements: The cutter must be adjacent to an enemy.

effect.description: The cutter shifts 3 squares to another square adjacent to the enemy.

powers.name: Swift Strike
powers.trigger: An enemy misses the cutter with a melee attack.

effect.description: The cutter shifts 4 squares and uses barbed dagger.
